name_zh: 107年低收入戶及中低收入戶生活狀況調查－人資料
name_en: The Low-income and Middle-income Family Living Condition Survey
data_description_zh:
1. 本調查係為明瞭低收入戶及中低收入戶生活狀況，依社會救助法第 13 條規定約
每5 年辦理之調查。
2. 調查目的主要蒐集低收入戶及中低收入戶之家庭組成（包括有工作能力人口及其
就業意願）、住宅及設備狀況、戶內人口健康狀況、經濟情況，對政府辦理社會
救助（包括生活扶助、醫療補助、急難救助及災害救助）、福利措施之利用與期
望等資料，以作為規劃社會救助政策之參考。
notes_zh:
調查實施計畫、抽樣設計、調查表，可參閱衛生福利部統計處網頁址:
https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-1768-113.html)。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。

name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare4-107年低收入戶及中低收入戶生活狀況調查－人資料
data_description_en:
1. This survey is conducted approximately every 5 years pursuant to Article 13 of the Public Assistance Act, in order to understand the living conditions of low-income and middle-low-income households.
2. The purpose of the survey is mainly to collect data on the family composition of low-income and middle-low-income households (including the working-age population and their employment intentions), housing and facility conditions, the health status of household members, economic conditions, and their utilization of and expectations for government social assistance (including living subsidies, medical assistance, emergency relief, and disaster relief) and welfare measures, to serve as a reference for planning social assistance policy.
notes_en:
For the survey implementation plan, sampling design and questionnaire, see the website of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare, at:
https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-1768-113.html).
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address were deleted, and fields such as
national ID number, facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of visit and admission date are
masked. The data may be used only in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results that
pass review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
